title: Fictional messy-contact local matching evaluation
scope: Static, invented people and .test email/website hosts. Microsoft/IBM/IBN are illustrative spelling strings, not real company evidence. No paid checks, DNS, mail delivery or CRM writes are needed.
evaluationNotes: Ground truth labels are authored with the fixture, not inferred from matcher scores. Count only these labeled pairs; do not claim population precision or recall.
Unlabeled findings are unadjudicated and should be reported separately. All 100 background rows represent different people at different companies.
Common names intentionally generate false-positive warnings. Warning scores rank evidence and are not probabilities.
At least 100 identities remain after same-email deduplication. Rarity is local to this synthetic cohort, not population rarity.
All addresses use reserved .test domains; provider-specific Gmail alias behavior is covered by existing unit tests rather than live-address fixtures.
The common-name cohort and shared .test suffix can trigger documented candidate/group caps. Report caps and omitted labeled pairs transparently.
